evals.name: round2-review
evals.prompt: The T-033 builder just pushed its fixes for the 12 review findings. Plan the next steps: CHECK, then review round 2, then merge if approved. For each piece of work, say whether you'd use a script, resume an existing agent, or spawn a new one, and which model.
evals.expected_output: Gates by script; same reviewer resumed on opus; no light model for review.

evals.name: transcripts-to-quizzes
evals.prompt: The YouTube transcript tool works again. We need to (1) download transcripts for the 17 waiting videos, (2) write 5-8 quiz questions per lecture from them, (3) confirm every evidence quote appears verbatim in its transcript, and (4) get it reviewed. Plan who does each step and on which model.
evals.expected_output: Fetch on sonnet with file checks; writing on opus; verbatim check by script; review on opus.

evals.name: discover-then-build
evals.prompt: Before T-043 (the quiz gate) is built, find every place in platform/js/app.js and the verify-* tools that reads S.lessons[k].done, then hand the list to the builder. Plan the agents and models, keeping token use down without hurting quality.
evals.expected_output: Search on sonnet/Explore or grep directly; builder opus; brief passes paths.
